picks.name: Second Storey
picks.source_note: Already in your library. Launches his new label, High Canopy.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Ladakh EP" (September 18, 2026, High Canopy) launches Second Storey's own label, 20 years after his first vinyl release -- five tracks spanning mechanised, cerebral dancefloor workouts and deeper, more experimental ambient terrain.
picks.why_listen: A genre-roaming EP from a long-running favorite -- a new label to watch alongside dancefloor and headier textures in one release.

picks.name: Skepta
picks.source_note: Already in your library (Bass playlist). Here with Chase & Status and Suggs in club-skewed breakbeat territory.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Innocent Smile" (September 18, 2026, Big Smoke/Epic) pairs Skepta with Chase & Status and Madness's Suggs -- a fast, restless breakbeat-driven single with a Gorillaz-esque chorus, from Skepta's forthcoming album The Fork and Knife.
picks.why_listen: A high-octane, big-beat curveball from an unexpected pairing -- a fun, energetic change of pace for a set.
